annotations.title: Find emails for an SFTP file

description:
Start a bulk email finder of a file already in the SFTP/FTP storage connected to the ZeroBounce account.
When to use: When the user's list is in their SFTP/FTP storage rather than uploaded here.
Parameters: fileName — the file's name in that storage; returnUrl — HTTPS URL notified when the job finishes (required by the API); hasHeaderRow (optional) — whether the first row is a header; removeDuplicates (optional).
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

fileName.description: Path of the file on your configured SFTP/FTP server

hasHeaderRow.description: Whether the first row is a header row. Defaults to false.

removeDuplicates.description: Whether to drop duplicate rows before processing.

returnUrl.description: HTTPS callback URL notified when the job completes. Required: the API refuses a job without one. Only use trusted URLs you control; an attacker-controlled URL can receive bulk results.
